title: Hay barn
description: Classic drive-through hay barn along Z, open at both ends: weathered barn-red board walls with darker battens, white corner boards, wall caps and set-in white-framed windows, a red gable over each doorway on a white header beam, a dark gambrel roof with white fascia, a hayloft door with a white X brace and a hoist beam (pulley, rope, hook) on the +Z gable, a blank light signboard (node `signboard`, front face UVs 0..1) below it, and round bales stacked along both walls inside, clear of an 11 m drive lane. Nodes walls / gables / roof / signboard so the game can hide the top while a vehicle is inside.
checks: FRONT tile: a wide open doorway you can see right through, a light signboard on a dark frame above it, a hayloft door with a white X brace above that and a hoist beam sticking out under the roof peak
FRONT tile: the roof has the gambrel shape (a steep lower slope breaking to a shallow upper slope on each side) with a white fascia
3/4 tile: red board walls with darker battens, white corner boards and trim, windows that read as set into the wall (frame ring, flush glass, sill)
LEFT tile: three windows along the side wall
BACK tile: the same open doorway and gable, no signboard and no hayloft door
TOP tile: a dark roof with a ridge down the middle along Z
